question: What remains in the body when limitation has dissolved?
premises: Outwardness and limitation have dissolved in the body.
Nothing remains apart from the essence of Shiva-bliss.
The body is filled with Shiva-bliss and pervaded by the thirty-six principles.
inference: When limitation dissolves, the body is revealed as nothing but Shiva-bliss encompassing all thirty-six principles.
plain_english: When limitation has dissolved, what would remain in the body apart from the essence of Shiva-bliss? The body is filled with the essence of Shiva-bliss and pervaded by the thirty-six principles.
